title: Remove and refit the engine generator
completeness: Complete bounded bench operation from the declared entry state to the declared exit state. Whole-bike access and downstream engine closure are separate dependencies.

source.review_note: All cited operation pages visually reviewed. General symbols and conditional torque rules retained.

applicability.included: Exact US2026 YZ450F standard stock components only
excluded: Engine removal and harness routing closure

required_tools.name: T25 bit; torque wrench accurate at10/65Nm

required_parts.name: New left-cover gasket and oil-tank drain washer

preflight: Engine removed, oil drained, shift pedal removed and electrical couplers disconnected.
entry_state: Engine removed, oil drained, shift pedal removed and electrical couplers disconnected.
exit_state: Generator and left cover installed; harness remains disconnected for engine refit.
critical_stop_conditions: Any required measurement unresolved or replacement criteria not satisfied.
Unidentified diagram orientation, missing parts, damage or abnormal binding.

material_policy.LT: Locking agent (LOCTITE) per PDF7. Grade unspecified by this manual; no grade inferred.
material_policy.lubrication: Follow each explicit E/M/LS/S application; general dry torque does not override a lubricated joint.

steps.title: Confirm engine-bench access
steps.instruction: Start with the removed engine securely supported, oil drained, shift pedal removed and stator/position-sensor harness couplers disconnected. Record the two external lead clamps and holder positions before removing the left cover.
verification: Oil drained, couplers disconnected, clamps identified.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Remove the left cover
steps.instruction: Release the cover fasteners progressively, remove the external clamps/holder and lift off the left crankcase cover. Retain both dowels and discard the gasket. Preserve the oil-tank drain-bolt washer location.
verification: Cover, two dowels and hardware retained.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Release the stator assembly
steps.instruction: Remove the lead clamp/crank-position sensor bolts and three stator screws. Release the lead grommet and remove the assembly without pulling on its wires. Keep the rotor and crankshaft undisturbed until the next step.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Pull the rotor
steps.instruction: Hold the rotor at the illustrated wrenching flats while removing its nut and washer. Use rotor puller90890-04151/YM-04151 to remove the rotor. Remove and retain the woodruff key; do not pry against the stator surface.
verification: Rotor pulled with specified tool; key and washer retained.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Inspect contact and key surfaces
steps.instruction: Inspect rotor inner surface and stator outer surface for contact damage. Damage requires crankshaft runout and bearing inspection before reassembly. Replace a damaged woodruff key. Record the result; electrical diagnosis is separate.
verification: Contact-surface and key condition recorded; any crank/bearing fault resolved.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Install stator, sensor and grommet
steps.instruction: Refit the stator with its three screws at10Nm using LOCTITE and aT25 bit. Refit crank-position sensor bolts at10Nm using LOCTITE. Apply YamahaBond1215/ThreeBond1215 to the lead grommet and route the lead through the cover side exactly as illustrated.
verification: Stator/sensor10Nm, locking agent and1215 grommet seal recorded.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Install the keyed rotor
steps.instruction: Clean both tapered mating surfaces. Fit the woodruff key with its flat face parallel to the crankshaft centerline. Align the rotor keyway with the key, seat the rotor, install washer/nut and hold the illustrated flats while tightening to65Nm.
verification: Key alignment, clean taper and65Nm saved.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow

steps.title: Close the left side
steps.instruction: Fit both dowels and a new left-cover gasket. Return the cover, lead clamps and holder to their diagram locations. Tighten cover bolts progressively in a crisscross pattern to10Nm. Fit a new oil-tank drain washer and tighten that drain bolt10Nm. Leave harness reconnection for engine installation with the routing guide.
verification: New gasket/washer, dowels and all10Nm closures checked.
steps.origin: Original source-based summary; observation fields are application workflow
